Coxhead,Bert Footer, Syd King, Harry Parker Seated:(Left to Right) ------, ------, F. L. Buckingham,Frank Thomson,Harry 'Spider' Bruce,Jimmy Flatt, Arthur Lamm, ------,------.

This is thought to be the start of the Club '10' of 1926. Of the 11 starters, 9 finished. Winner was the smartly turned-out Bert Footer. (3rd from right) alongside of whom is the bespectacled Wally Bayliss who was to become our President, but probably retired from this race. Runner up to Footer was Micky Pyer (extreme left) who won in 1923 and 1924; with George Still (extreme right) 3rd. A.E. Smith (second from left) was 5th and J.G. Flatt (fourth from left) 6th.
Names to fit the faces left to right are: -. Mitchell, H.W.Shields (Mx), J.E.Flower (Mx), A.Allum (Mx), W.Bayliss, A.W.Penny (Sy), A.E.Taylor (Sy), H.E.Footer (Sy), C.T.Carter (Sy).

Micky Pyer (extreme left) lines up at the start of the Belgrave 10 mile C.C. Championship in 1926. Having won the title in 1923 and 1924, this time he had to give way to his captain Bert Footer.
Left to right: A.D.Pyer, A.E.Smith, -, J.G.Flatt, -, -, -, -, H.E.Footer, W.L.Bayliss, G.Still.

27th January 1937---Part of Belgrave's winning team which beat U.S.M. (Paris) pose with Surrey's winning inter-county team at the Television studios, Alexandra Palace. But for our match in Paris coinciding with the inter-county championship, Carter,Penny,Footer and Cohen would have been included in the Surrey team. Belgravians are (l to r) rear row: W.L. Bayliss (President), A.R. Shaw. Centre row: C.T. Carter, A.W. Penny, J.A. Kemp, L.J. Cohen. Front row: A.E. Taylor, H.E. Footer. The central figure is, of course, J.C. Crump and the man on the extreme right, Denis Brickwood--then of Mitcham AC. Six days after these teams were televised by the Baird process, it was announced by the B.B.C. that the E.M.I. process would be adopted!

FLASHBACK TO 1934, shows Belgrave's cross-country runners and officials with their trophy collection which includes the London-Brighton (News of the World) Trophy, Southern and Surrey County cups. The team was also placed in the National and South of Thames Senior and Junior races.
BACK ROW (l.to r.):E.A.Duffett,R.Savage,A.T.Jordan,B.Lindsey,S.T.Ring,F.R.Webb,N.Dewberry, A. Robertshaw, W. Mitchell, A. Patience, L. Rollins.
CENTRE ROW (l. to r.):T.Eaton(masseur),D.Patience,R.Patience,J.Belchamber(Past President), W.H.Hare(Hon.Tresurer),J.R.McKay(President),W.Bayliss(General Hon.Secretary),E.Gordon(Past President),F.Walker,C.Penny,WG.Webb.
FRONT ROW (l. to r.):W.Rice,C.T.Carter,H.W.Shields,J.Flower,A.W.Penny,S.Warboys,A.Shaw, A.Taylor,[illegible].E.Footer(Captain), A.Allum.

CLUB CHAMPIONSHIPS 1934-----Presentation of Awards

Jock R. McKay (left), President of Belgrave Harriers, assists the Mayor of Battersea during the Presentation. To the right is the bespectacled W.L. Bayliss, Hon. Secretary, and to the far right (applauding)W.Redgrave, a Vice-President for many years and now in his 90's.
